quiz.question: ____ bail
quiz.explanation: 保释金, 缴纳保释金. The lawyer helped post bail for the defendant. 律师帮助为被告缴纳保释金。 | bail->桶/保释，bail->（交桶装钱）保释 || 文化联想：现代法院里被告交纳保证金后等待审理的概念最适合帮助记忆 bail，可以说 **post bail — “In a legal system that permits it, a defendant may post bail and remain free while awaiting trial.”**

quiz.question: hail _____
quiz.explanation: 冰雹, 冰雹风暴. The hail storm damaged crops in the fields. 冰雹风暴损坏了田里的庄稼。 | hail->冰雹/欢呼，hail storm->冰雹暴风（注意一词两义） || 文化联想：夏季强对流天气可能突然下冰雹，最适合帮助记忆 hail，可以说 **a hail storm — “A summer thunderstorm in northern China may turn into a hail storm that damages fruit trees and crops.”**

quiz.question: ______ blackmail
quiz.explanation: 勒索, 进行勒索. The criminal attempted to commit blackmail. 罪犯试图进行勒索。 | black->黑色/非法，mail->租金，blackmail->非法索要钱财=勒索 || 文化联想：中文“拿把柄敲诈”最适合帮助记忆 blackmail，可以说 **commit blackmail — “Threatening to expose a private secret unless someone pays money is to commit blackmail.”**

quiz.question: rail _______
quiz.explanation: 抱怨, 抱怨. He would rail against injustice in society. 他会抱怨社会的不公正。 | rail->栏杆/猛烈抨击，rail against->强烈抗议 || 文化联想：鲁迅杂文常猛烈抨击社会弊病，最适合帮助记忆 rail，可以说 **rail against injustice — “A sharp essay may rail against injustice and hypocrisy with deliberately forceful language.”**

quiz.question: assail ___ ________
quiz.explanation: 攻击, 攻击阵地. The army prepared to assail the position. 军队准备攻击阵地。 | as->朝向，sail->跳跃，assail->跳扑上去=攻击（cf. assault攻击） || 文化联想：中文“群起而攻之”最适合帮助记忆 assail，可以说 **assail a position — “Critics may assail a policy position from every direction when they believe it is badly flawed.”**

quiz.question: entail _____
quiz.explanation: 需要, 需要成本. The project will entail costs beyond the budget. 该项目将需要超出预算的成本。 | en->使，tail->切割，entail->切割限定=必然包含/需要 || 文化联想：买房不仅要付房价，还会牵涉税费、维修和利息，最适合帮助记忆 entail，可以说 **entail extra costs — “Buying a home can entail extra costs such as taxes, insurance, repairs, and interest.”**

quiz.question: curtail ________
quiz.explanation: 削减, 削减开支. The company had to curtail spending due to losses. 由于亏损,公司不得不削减开支。 | curt->短，tail->尾巴，curtail->截断尾巴=削减 || 文化联想：中文“勒紧裤腰带”最适合帮助记忆 curtail，可以说 **curtail spending — “When income falls, a household may curtail spending—‘勒紧裤腰带’—until finances recover.”**

quiz.question: prevail ____
quiz.explanation: 劝说, 劝说. She managed to prevail upon him to reconsider. 她设法劝说他重新考虑。 | pre->前，vail->强壮，prevail->压倒性强壮=占优/劝服 || 文化联想：中文“坚持到底最终胜出”最适合帮助记忆 prevail，可以说 **prevail upon someone — “After repeated discussion, a family may prevail upon an elderly relative to accept needed medical help.”**

quiz.question: stencil _______
quiz.explanation: 模板, 模板图案. The artist used a stencil pattern for the design. 艺术家使用模板图案进行设计。 | stencil->闪光（镂空后透光），stencil->镂花模板 || 文化联想：中国剪纸常先画好或套用模板再剪出重复纹样，很适合帮助记忆 stencil，可以说 **a stencil pattern — “A craft teacher may use a stencil pattern to help children reproduce the same decorative motif on paper.”**

quiz.question: nonpareil _______
quiz.explanation: 无与伦比的, 无与伦比的质量. The product is of nonpareil quality. 该产品具有无与伦比的质量。 | non->无，pareil->同等（法语），nonpareil->没有同等的=无与伦比的 || 文化联想：中文“天下无双”最适合帮助记忆 nonpareil，可以说 **nonpareil quality — “A masterpiece praised as ‘天下无双’ is being celebrated for nonpareil quality with no equal.”**

quiz.question: ______ veil
quiz.explanation: 面纱, 新娘面纱. The bride wore a beautiful bridal veil. 新娘戴着美丽的新娘面纱。 | vel->遮盖，veil->遮盖物=面纱（cf. reveal揭开=re+veil） || 文化联想：传统中式婚礼通常不用西式面纱，但现代婚礼常见新娘戴 veil，可用这种现代场景记忆，可以说 **a bridal veil — “At a modern Chinese wedding, a bride may wear a white bridal veil during the ceremony.”**

quiz.question: fulfil _ _______
quiz.explanation: 履行, 履行诺言. He always strives to fulfil a promise he makes. 他总是努力履行他做出的诺言。 | full->充满，fill->填满，fulfil->完全填满=履行/实现 || 文化联想：中文“言必信，行必果”最适合帮助记忆 fulfil，可以说 **fulfil a promise — “Someone who lives by ‘言必信，行必果’ tries to fulfil every promise once it is made.”**

quiz.question: ____ __ nil
quiz.explanation: 零, 化为零. Their efforts seemed to come to nil. 他们的努力似乎化为零。 | nil->零（拉丁nihil），come to nil->化为乌有 || 文化联想：中文“化为乌有”最适合帮助记忆 nil，可以说 **come to nil — “Months of negotiation may come to nil if both sides walk away without any agreement.”**

quiz.question: foil ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 挫败, 挫败阴谋. The detective managed to foil the plot. 侦探设法挫败了阴谋。 | foil->箔/衬托/挫败，foil the plot->使阴谋落空 || 文化联想：《三国演义》里诸葛亮识破敌方计谋并加以破坏，最适合帮助记忆 foil，可以说 **foil a plot — “A clever strategist may uncover an enemy conspiracy in time to foil the plot.”**

quiz.question: spoil ___ ___
quiz.explanation: 破坏, 破坏乐趣. Don't spoil the fun with negative comments. 不要用消极评论破坏乐趣。 | spoil->掠夺/腐败/破坏，spoil the fun->扫兴 || 文化联想：中文“扫兴”最适合帮助记忆 spoil，可以说 **spoil the fun — “A sudden argument during a family outing can spoil the fun for everyone.”**

quiz.question: despoil ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 掠夺, 掠夺土地. Invaders would despoil the land of resources. 侵略者会掠夺土地资源。 | de->加强，spoil->掠夺，despoil->彻底掠夺 || 文化联想：古代战争中军队烧毁农田、抢掠村庄的场景最适合帮助记忆 despoil，可以说 **despoil the land — “An invading army that burns crops and steals livestock may despoil the land it passes through.”**

quiz.question: roil ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 搅乱, 搅乱市场. The scandal continued to roil the market. 丑闻继续搅乱市场。 | roil->搅浑（水），roil the market->搅乱市场（cf. rile激怒） || 文化联想：一条监管消息可能迅速搅动股市，最适合帮助记忆 roil，可以说 **roil the market — “An unexpected policy announcement can roil the market and send prices swinging sharply.”**

quiz.question: broil _____
quiz.explanation: 烤, 烤牛排. The chef will broil steak for dinner. 厨师将为晚餐烤牛排。 | broil->炙烤/纷争，broil steak->直火烤牛排 || 文化联想：中国西餐厅也常用上火烤制牛排，最适合帮助记忆 broil，可以说 **broil a steak — “A restaurant cook may broil a steak under intense heat to brown the surface quickly.”**

quiz.question: embroil __ _______
quiz.explanation: 卷入, 卷入丑闻. The politician became embroil in scandal. 这位政客卷入了丑闻。 | em->进入，broil->纷争，embroil->卷入纷争中 || 文化联想：中文“卷入丑闻”最适合帮助记忆 embroil，可以说 **be embroiled in scandal — “A public figure may become embroiled in scandal after leaked messages trigger a major investigation.”**

quiz.question: imperil ______
quiz.explanation: 危及, 危及安全. Reckless driving will imperil safety on roads. 鲁莽驾驶会危及道路安全。 | im->使成为，peril->危险，imperil->使陷入危险=危及 || 文化联想：工地上忽视安全规范会危及工人安全，最适合帮助记忆 imperil，可以说 **imperil safety — “Removing protective barriers to save time can imperil safety on a construction site.”**

quiz.question: _______ utensil
quiz.explanation: 器具, 厨房器具. She stored kitchen utensil in drawers. 她把厨房器具存放在抽屉里。 | uten->使用，utensil->使用的工具=器具（cf. use使用） || 文化联想：中餐厨房里的锅铲、漏勺、筷子都是 utensil 的直观例子，可以说 **a kitchen utensil — “A wok spatula is a common kitchen utensil used for stir-frying Chinese dishes.”**

quiz.question: cavil __ _______
quiz.explanation: 挑剔, 对细节挑剔. Critics cavil at details but miss the main point. 批评者对细节挑剔但错过了要点。 | cav->空洞，cavil->找空洞=无理挑剔 || 文化联想：中文“鸡蛋里挑骨头”最适合帮助记忆 cavil，可以说 **cavil at details — “Someone who keeps objecting to tiny wording choices may cavil at details—‘鸡蛋里挑骨头.’”**

quiz.question: daredevil _____
quiz.explanation: 冒险者, 冒险特技. The actor performed a dangerous daredevil stunt. 演员表演了一个危险的冒险特技。 | dare->敢，devil->魔鬼，daredevil->敢于挑战魔鬼的人=亡命之徒 || 文化联想：杂技演员走钢丝、骑独轮车做高风险动作，最适合帮助记忆 daredevil，可以说 **a daredevil stunt — “A circus performer crossing a high wire without a safety net is attempting a daredevil stunt.”**

quiz.question: __________'_ anvil
quiz.explanation: 铁砧, 铁匠的铁砧. The blacksmith's anvil rang with each hammer blow. 铁匠的铁砧随着每次锤击而响起。 | an->在上，vil->打击，anvil->在上面打击的台=铁砧 || 文化联想：传统铁匠铺里打铁用的大铁砧最适合帮助记忆 anvil，可以说 **a blacksmith’s anvil — “A village blacksmith hammers red-hot iron against a heavy anvil to shape a tool.”**

quiz.question: blackball _ _________
quiz.explanation: 投票反对, 投票反对候选人. Club members voted to blackball a candidate. 俱乐部成员投票反对一位候选人。 | black->黑色，ball->球，blackball->投黑球否决（古代投票用黑球表示反对） || 文化联想：中文“暗中封杀候选人”最适合帮助记忆 blackball，可以说 **blackball a candidate — “Members of a private association may secretly vote to blackball a candidate and keep that person out.”**

quiz.question: ______ pitfall
quiz.explanation: 陷阱, 隐藏的陷阱. Investors must avoid hidden pitfall in contracts. 投资者必须避免合同中隐藏的陷阱。 | pit->坑，fall->落入，pitfall->落入坑中=陷阱 || 文化联想：中文“坑”最适合帮助记忆 pitfall，可以说 **a hidden pitfall — “A contract that looks attractive at first may contain a hidden pitfall buried in the fine print—一个容易踩进去的‘坑.’”**

quiz.question: ____ _ pall
quiz.explanation: 笼罩, 投下阴影. The tragedy would cast a pall over celebrations. 悲剧会给庆祝活动投下阴影。 | pall->棺材布/阴影，cast a pall->投下一层阴影 || 文化联想：中文“给未来蒙上一层阴影”最适合帮助记忆 pall，可以说 **cast a pall — “News of a serious accident can cast a pall over an otherwise joyful holiday gathering.”**

quiz.question: __ thrall __
quiz.explanation: 奴役, 受奴役于. He lived in thrall to his addiction. 他受奴役于他的成瘾。 | thrall->奴隶（古英语），in thrall to->受控于/被奴役于 || 文化联想：中文“受人摆布”最适合帮助记忆 thrall，可以说 **in thrall to someone — “A court official who obeys a powerful patron in everything may live in thrall to that patron’s influence.”**

quiz.question: ______ stall
quiz.explanation: 摊位, 市场摊位. Vendors sold produce from their market stall. 小贩从他们的市场摊位出售农产品。 | stall->摊位/停滞，market stall->市场摊位 || 文化联想：中国菜市场一排排卖菜、卖水果的小摊最适合帮助记忆 stall，可以说 **a market stall — “At a Chinese wet market, a vendor may sell vegetables and fruit from a small market stall.”**

quiz.question: forestall _ ______
quiz.explanation: 预防, 预防危机. Quick action helped forestall a crisis. 迅速行动帮助预防了危机。 | fore->提前，stall->阻止，forestall->提前阻止=预防 || 文化联想：汛期提前疏通排水、腾出水库库容，是 forestall 很直观的防患未然场景，可以说 **forestall a crisis — “Clearing drains and preparing reservoirs before heavy rain can help forestall a flood crisis.”**

quiz.question: install ________
quiz.explanation: 安装, 安装软件. The technician will install software on all computers. 技术人员将在所有计算机上安装软件。 | in->进入，stall->摊位/位置，install->放入指定位置=安装 || 文化联想：中国人换新手机后第一件事之一常是安装微信等应用，最适合帮助记忆 install，可以说 **install an app — “After buying a new phone, a user may install WeChat and other essential apps.”**

quiz.question: ______ squall
quiz.explanation: 暴风, 突然的暴风. A sudden squall caught sailors by surprise. 突然的暴风让水手措手不及。 | squall->尖叫/暴风（象声词，风的嚎叫声） || 文化联想：夏季西湖或海边突然刮起一阵急风骤雨，最适合帮助记忆 squall，可以说 **a sudden squall — “A sudden squall over a lake can force small boats to hurry back toward shore.”**

quiz.question: stonewall ________
quiz.explanation: 阻碍, 阻碍质询. The official tried to stonewall question from reporters. 官员试图阻碍记者的质询。 | stone->石头，wall->墙，stonewall->筑石墙阻挡=拒绝回答 || 文化联想：中文“打太极、不正面回答”最适合帮助记忆 stonewall，可以说 **stonewall reporters — “An official who keeps giving vague answers instead of addressing a question may stonewall reporters—像是在‘打太极.’”**

quiz.question: fell _____
quiz.explanation: 凶猛的, 一举. The army took the city in one fell swoop. 军队一举拿下了这座城市。 | fell->凶猛的（古英语），one fell swoop->一击即中=一举 || 文化联想：中文“一举拿下”最适合帮助记忆 fell，可以说 **in one fell swoop — “A successful operation that solves several problems at once can be said to do so in one fell swoop—‘一举拿下.’”**

quiz.question: pell-mell ____
quiz.explanation: 混乱地, 混乱的冲刺. People made a pell-mell rush for the exits. 人们混乱地冲向出口。 | pell-mell->乱作一团（法语pêle-mêle，混乱混杂） || 文化联想：中文“一窝蜂地冲过去”最适合帮助记忆 pell-mell，可以说 **a pell-mell rush — “When the doors open, an excited crowd may make a pell-mell rush forward—像‘一窝蜂’一样.”**

quiz.question: _____ mill
quiz.explanation: 磨坊, 谷物磨坊. The old grain mill still operates today. 古老的谷物磨坊今天仍在运营。 | mill->磨，grain mill->磨谷物的坊=谷物磨坊 || 文化联想：中国农村传统石磨磨面、磨豆浆的场景最适合帮助记忆 mill，可以说 **a grain mill — “An old village grain mill may grind wheat or corn into flour with heavy millstones.”**

quiz.question: _____ drill
quiz.explanation: 钻头, 电钻. The carpenter used a power drill for the job. 木匠用电钻完成工作。 | drill->钻孔/操练，power drill->电动钻头 || 文化联想：木工师傅装柜子时用电钻打孔最适合帮助记忆 drill，可以说 **a power drill — “A carpenter installing kitchen cabinets may use a power drill to make holes for screws.”**

quiz.question: distill _____
quiz.explanation: 蒸馏, 蒸馏水. The lab equipment can distill water for experiments. 实验室设备可以为实验蒸馏水。 | di->分开，still->滴落，distill->使液体滴落分离=蒸馏 || 文化联想：中国白酒酿造中蒸馏是重要步骤之一，最适合帮助记忆 distill，可以说 **distill a spirit — “A traditional distillery can distill fermented grain to produce a clear Chinese spirit.”**

quiz.question: instill ______
quiz.explanation: 灌输, 灌输价值观. Parents work to instill values in their children. 父母努力向孩子灌输价值观。 | in->向内，still->滴入，instill->一滴一滴注入=灌输 || 文化联想：中文“家风”最适合帮助记忆 instill，因为价值观常被一点点传给下一代，可以说 **instill family values — “Parents and grandparents may try to instill family values through everyday example and repeated teaching.”**

quiz.question: ______ knoll
quiz.explanation: 小山丘, 长满草的小山丘. They picnicked on a grassy knoll overlooking the valley. 他们在俯瞰山谷的长满草的小山丘上野餐。 | knoll->小圆丘（cf. kneel跪，膝盖高度的小丘） || 文化联想：内蒙古草原上一个低矮圆润的小山丘最适合帮助记忆 knoll，可以说 **a grassy knoll — “A shepherd may sit on a grassy knoll overlooking the open grassland.”**

quiz.question: ____ poll
quiz.explanation: 民意调查, 出口民意调查. The exit poll predicted election results accurately. 出口民意调查准确预测了选举结果。 | poll->头部/计数，exit poll->出口处清点意见=出口民调 || 文化联想：中文网络投票和问卷调查最适合帮助记忆 poll，可以说 **an online poll — “A news website may run an online poll asking readers which issue concerns them most.”**

quiz.question: droll _____
quiz.explanation: 滑稽的, 滑稽的幽默. His droll humor kept everyone entertained. 他滑稽的幽默让每个人都很开心。 | droll->滚动的小人（荷兰语trol），droll->逗趣滑稽的 || 文化联想：相声里那种一本正经说出滑稽话的幽默最适合帮助记忆 droll，可以说 **droll humor — “A xiangsheng performer may use droll humor by delivering an absurd line with a completely serious face.”**

quiz.question: stroll ______
quiz.explanation: 漫步, 四处漫步. Couples stroll around the park at sunset. 情侣们在日落时分四处漫步于公园。 | stroll->悠闲滚动前行=漫步（cf. scroll卷轴/滚动） || 文化联想：晚饭后在西湖边或社区公园慢慢散步最适合帮助记忆 stroll，可以说 **take a stroll — “After dinner, a couple may take a stroll along West Lake or through a neighborhood park.”**

quiz.question: ____ toll
quiz.explanation: 通行费, 道路通行费. Drivers must pay road toll to use the highway. 司机必须支付道路通行费才能使用高速公路。 | toll->计数/敲钟/收费，road toll->过路费 || 文化联想：中国高速公路使用 ETC 自动收取通行费，最适合帮助记忆 toll，可以说 **a road toll — “A driver passing through an ETC lane can pay the road toll automatically without stopping for cash.”**

quiz.question: dull ____
quiz.explanation: 钝痛, 钝痛. He felt a dull ache in his shoulder. 他感到肩膀有钝痛。 | dull->迟钝/不锋利，dull ache->不锐利的痛=钝痛 || 文化联想：爬完长城第二天腿部隐隐酸痛的感觉很适合帮助记忆 dull，可以说 **a dull ache — “After a long day of climbing the Great Wall, a traveler may feel a dull ache in the legs.”**

quiz.question: ___ gull
quiz.explanation: 海鸥, 海鸥. A sea gull circled overhead looking for food. 一只海鸥在头顶盘旋寻找食物。 | gull->海鸥/欺骗，sea gull->海上的鸟=海鸥 || 文化联想：昆明滇池冬季成群海鸥盘旋的画面最适合帮助记忆 gull，可以说 **a sea gull — “A gull circling above Dianchi Lake may swoop down toward food tossed by visitors.”**

quiz.question: ____ hull
quiz.explanation: 船体, 船体. The ship hull was damaged by the rocks. 船体被岩石损坏。 | hull->外壳/剥壳，ship hull->船的外壳=船体 || 文化联想：长江货轮最外面的船体就是 hull，最适合帮助记忆，可以说 **a ship hull — “A Yangtze cargo vessel must have its ship hull inspected regularly for cracks and corrosion.”**

quiz.question: ________ idyll
quiz.explanation: 田园诗, 田园牧歌. The poem described a pastoral idyll of rural life. 这首诗描述了乡村生活的田园牧歌。 | idyll->小画/小诗（希腊），idyll->田园牧歌（cf. idol偶像，同音近形） || 文化联想：陶渊明笔下宁静自足的乡村生活最适合帮助记忆 idyll，可以说 **a pastoral idyll — “Tao Yuanming’s poetry often evokes a pastoral idyll of fields, cottages, wine, and quiet rural work.”**

quiz.question: ___ idol
quiz.explanation: 偶像, 流行偶像. The teenager's room was covered with pop idol posters. 青少年的房间里贴满了流行偶像海报。 | idol->形象/偶像（cf. idyll田园诗，注意区分） || 文化联想：中文娱乐文化里的“偶像明星”最适合帮助记忆 idol，可以说 **a pop idol — “A teenager may cover a bedroom wall with posters of a favorite pop idol.”**

quiz.question: menthol _____
quiz.explanation: 薄荷醇, 薄荷糖. The menthol candy soothed her sore throat. 薄荷糖缓解了她的喉咙痛。 | menth->薄荷，ol->醇，menthol->薄荷醇 || 文化联想：中国药店里常见带清凉感的薄荷含片最适合帮助记忆 menthol，可以说 **a menthol lozenge — “A pharmacy may sell a menthol lozenge that gives the throat a cool sensation.”**

quiz.question: _____ whirlpool
quiz.explanation: 漩涡, 水漩涡. The water whirlpool pulled debris under the surface. 水漩涡将碎片拉到水面下。 | whirl->旋转，pool->水池，whirlpool->旋转的水=漩涡 || 文化联想：黄河急流或水坝下方出现旋转水流的画面最适合帮助记忆 whirlpool，可以说 **a dangerous whirlpool — “Fast-moving water below a dam can form a dangerous whirlpool that pulls floating debris inward.”**

quiz.question: ______ spool
quiz.explanation: 线轴, 线轴. She wound the thread spool for sewing. 她缠绕线轴以备缝纫。 | spool->线圈/轴（cf. pool合并，同韵） || 文化联想：苏绣工匠使用一轴轴细丝线刺绣，最适合帮助记忆 spool，可以说 **a spool of thread — “A Suzhou embroiderer may unwind silk from a spool of thread while stitching a detailed pattern.”**

quiz.question: ____ carol
quiz.explanation: 颂歌, 唱颂歌. Children gather to sing carol at Christmas. 孩子们聚在一起在圣诞节唱颂歌。 | carol->欢唱/颂歌（cf. chorus合唱） || 文化联想：carol 是基督教圣诞颂歌，可用上海等城市教堂圣诞礼拜的场景来记忆，可以说 **sing a carol — “At Christmas, children in a church choir in China may gather to sing a carol together.”**

quiz.question: pistol ____
quiz.explanation: 手枪, 手枪射击. The race began with a pistol shot. 比赛以手枪射击开始。 | pistol->手枪（捷克pist->管子），pistol shot->手枪射击 || 文化联想：运动会起跑声常让人联想到发令枪，最适合帮助记忆 pistol，可以说 **a starting-pistol shot — “At an athletics meet, runners may begin the race at the sound of a starting-pistol shot.”**

quiz.question: extol ___ _______
quiz.explanation: 赞美, 赞美美德. The speaker continued to extol the virtues of hard work. 演讲者继续赞美努力工作的美德。 | ex->向上，tol->举起，extol->高高举起=颂扬 || 文化联想：中文“赞美勤劳美德”最适合帮助记忆 extol，可以说 **extol the virtues of hard work — “A traditional family saying may extol the virtues of hard work, thrift, and perseverance.”**

quiz.question: _____ churl
quiz.explanation: 粗人, 脾气坏的粗人. The surly churl refused to help anyone. 脾气坏的粗人拒绝帮助任何人。 | churl->农奴/粗鄙之人，churlish->粗鲁无礼的 || 文化联想：中文“粗鄙无礼的家伙”最适合帮助记忆 churl，可以说 **a surly churl — “A man who insults guests and refuses basic courtesy may be dismissed as a surly churl.”**

quiz.question: ______ overhaul
quiz.explanation: 大修, 发动机大修. The mechanic performed an engine overhaul. 机械师进行了发动机大修。 | over->全面，haul->拖拉，overhaul->全面拖出检修=大修 || 文化联想：中国汽修厂把老车发动机彻底拆检维修的场景最适合帮助记忆 overhaul，可以说 **an engine overhaul — “A mechanic may perform an engine overhaul on an old truck by dismantling, inspecting, and replacing worn parts.”**

quiz.question: maul _ ______
quiz.explanation: 撕咬, 撕咬受害者. The wild animal could maul a victim severely. 野生动物可能会严重撕咬受害者。 | maul->重锤/猛击，maul->像锤击一样撕打 || 文化联想：野猪或大型野生动物猛烈攻击人畜的场景最适合帮助记忆 maul，可以说 **maul a victim — “A large wild animal can maul a victim severely if it attacks at close range.”**

quiz.question: resourceful ______
quiz.explanation: 足智多谋的, 足智多谋的领导者. The resourceful leader found solutions to every problem. 足智多谋的领导者为每个问题找到了解决方案。 | resource->资源，resourceful->善用资源的=足智多谋的 || 文化联想：诸葛亮足智多谋的文化形象最适合帮助记忆 resourceful，可以说 **a resourceful strategist — “In popular tradition, Zhuge Liang is a resourceful strategist who repeatedly finds solutions with limited resources.”**

quiz.question: vengeful ______
quiz.explanation: 复仇的, 复仇的精神. The legend spoke of a vengeful spirit. 传说讲述了一个复仇的精神。 | venge->复仇，vengeful->充满复仇欲的（cf. avenge复仇） || 文化联想：《聊斋志异》里一些鬼魂因冤屈而寻仇，最适合帮助记忆 vengeful，可以说 **a vengeful spirit — “A ghost in a Strange Tales story may return as a vengeful spirit seeking repayment for an old injustice.”**

quiz.question: dutiful ___
quiz.explanation: 尽职的, 尽职的儿子. The dutiful son cared for his aging parents. 尽职的儿子照顾年迈的父母。 | duty->职责，dutiful->充满职责感的=尽职的 || 文化联想：“孝子照顾年迈父母”最适合帮助记忆 dutiful，可以说 **a dutiful son — “A dutiful son may arrange medical visits, meals, and daily care for his aging parents.”**

quiz.question: willful _______
quiz.explanation: 故意的, 故意的忽视. The charge was willful neglect of duty. 指控是故意忽视职责。 | will->意志/故意，willful->出于意志的=故意的 || 文化联想：中文“明知故犯、故意不管”最适合帮助记忆 willful，可以说 **willful neglect — “Ignoring a serious safety problem after repeated warnings may amount to willful neglect.”**

quiz.question: blissful _______
quiz.explanation: 幸福的, 幸福的寂静. They enjoyed blissful silence in the countryside. 他们在乡村享受幸福的寂静。 | bliss->极乐，blissful->充满极乐的=幸福的 || 文化联想：雪后寺院或山村安静得只听见风声的感觉很适合帮助记忆 blissful，可以说 **blissful silence — “After fresh snow falls on a mountain temple, visitors may enjoy a few minutes of blissful silence.”**

quiz.question: fitful _____
quiz.explanation: 断断续续的, 断断续续的睡眠. Anxiety caused fitful sleep throughout the night. 焦虑导致整夜断断续续的睡眠。 | fit->发作/间歇，fitful->一阵一阵发作的=断断续续的 || 文化联想：高考前夜因为紧张而睡睡醒醒，最适合帮助记忆 fitful，可以说 **fitful sleep — “An anxious student waiting for an important exam may get only fitful sleep through the night.”**

quiz.question: ________ mogul
quiz.explanation: 大亨, 商业大亨. The business mogul owned multiple companies. 商业大亨拥有多家公司。 | mogul->蒙古大汗，mogul->权贵大亨 || 文化联想：中文“商业大亨”最适合帮助记忆 mogul，可以说 **a business mogul — “A business mogul may control companies across property, retail, media, or technology.”**

quiz.question: annul ________
quiz.explanation: 废除, 废除婚姻. The court decided to annul marriage on legal grounds. 法院决定以法律理由废除婚姻。 | an->加强，nul->零/无效，annul->使归零=废除 || 文化联想：现代法院在特定法律理由成立时可以宣告婚姻无效，最适合帮助记忆 annul，可以说 **annul a marriage — “A court may annul a marriage if the law treats the marriage as invalid from the beginning.”**

quiz.question: foul _____
quiz.explanation: 恶臭的, 恶臭味. A foul smell filled the room. 恶臭味充满了房间。 | foul->腐烂/污秽，foul smell->令人厌恶的气味（cf. fowl禽类，同音） || 文化联想：下水道堵塞后飘出的恶臭最适合帮助记忆 foul，可以说 **a foul smell — “A blocked drain can fill an alley with a foul smell that sends pedestrians away.”**

quiz.question: _______ consul
quiz.explanation: 领事, 意大利领事. The Italian consul assisted citizens abroad. 意大利领事在海外协助公民。 | consul->共同商议者（拉丁），consul->领事（cf. council议会） || 文化联想：上海等城市有许多外国领事机构，最适合帮助记忆 consul，可以说 **an Italian consul — “An Italian consul in Shanghai may assist Italian citizens with official matters while they are abroad.”**

quiz.question: ______ awl
quiz.explanation: 锥子, 缝纫锥子. The cobbler used a sewing awl for leather work. 鞋匠使用缝纫锥子进行皮革工作。 | awl->锥子（古英语æl），sewing awl->缝纫用锥子 || 文化联想：传统鞋匠纳鞋底、扎皮革时使用锥子，最适合帮助记忆 awl，可以说 **a sewing awl — “A cobbler may use a sewing awl to punch holes through thick leather before stitching it.”**

quiz.question: trawl ___ ____
quiz.explanation: 搜寻, 搜寻数据. Researchers trawl for data in archives. 研究人员在档案中搜寻数据。 | trawl->拖网捕鱼，trawl for data->像拖网一样搜寻数据 || 文化联想：研究者在中国地方志和数字档案里大量搜资料，最适合帮助记忆 trawl，可以说 **trawl for data — “A historian may trawl for data through digitized gazetteers, newspapers, and archival records.”**

quiz.question: _______ sibyl
quiz.explanation: 女预言家, 古代女预言家. The ancient sibyl prophesied future events. 古代女预言家预言未来事件。 | sibyl->古希腊罗马神话中的女先知，sibylline->神秘预言的 || 文化联想：sibyl 是古希腊罗马的女先知，可用中国学生学习西方古典神话的场景来记忆，可以说 **an ancient sibyl — “In a Chinese university course on Greco-Roman myth, students may read about an ancient sibyl who delivers prophecies.”**

quiz.question: _____ beam
quiz.explanation: 光束, 激光束. The laser beam cut through the metal. 激光束切割金属。 | beam->光束/梁，laser beam->激光束 || 文化联想：中国工厂用激光切割钢板最适合帮助记忆 beam，可以说 **a laser beam — “A metalworking factory may use a focused laser beam to cut precise shapes from steel.”**

quiz.question: seam _________
quiz.explanation: 缝, 缝份. The pattern includes seam allowance measurements. 图案包括缝份尺寸。 | seam->缝合线（cf. seem看似，同音），seam allowance->缝份 || 文化联想：旗袍裁缝裁片时必须预留缝份，最适合帮助记忆 seam，可以说 **seam allowance — “A qipao tailor leaves enough seam allowance so the garment can be stitched and adjusted accurately.”**

quiz.question: _____ amalgam
quiz.explanation: 混合物, 金属混合物. Dentists used metal amalgam for fillings. 牙医使用金属混合物进行填充。 | amal->软化，gam->汞，amalgam->汞与金属的混合=合金/混合物 || 文化联想：上海这样的城市常被形容为多种建筑、饮食和文化的混合体，最适合帮助记忆 amalgam，可以说 **a cultural amalgam — “Modern Shanghai is a cultural amalgam shaped by Chinese traditions and many outside influences.”**

quiz.question: _______ logjam
quiz.explanation: 僵局, 交通僵局. The accident created a traffic logjam on the highway. 事故在高速公路上造成了交通僵局。 | log->原木，jam->堵塞，logjam->原木堵塞河道=僵局 || 文化联想：中文“堵成一团、陷入僵局”最适合帮助记忆 logjam，可以说 **a traffic logjam — “A crash on Beijing’s ring road can create a traffic logjam stretching for kilometers.”**

quiz.question: ____ clam
quiz.explanation: 蛤蜊, 硬壳蛤蜊. Divers collected hard clam from the ocean floor. 潜水员从海底收集硬壳蛤蜊。 | clam->夹住（蛤蜊紧夹），clam up->闭口不言（像蛤蜊一样夹紧） || 文化联想：青岛、大连等沿海城市的海鲜市场最适合帮助记忆 clam，可以说 **a hard clam — “At a coastal seafood market, a vendor may sell hard clams alongside oysters, shrimp, and fish.”**

quiz.question: _______ loam
quiz.explanation: 壤土, 肥沃的壤土. The garden had rich fertile loam for planting. 花园有丰富的肥沃壤土用于种植。 | loam->黏土质壤土（砂土+黏土+腐殖质的混合） || 文化联想：江南菜园里肥沃、松软的壤土最适合帮助记忆 loam，可以说 **fertile loam — “Vegetables grow well in fertile loam that contains a balanced mixture of sand, clay, and organic matter.”**

quiz.question: ram _______
quiz.explanation: 猛推, 强行通过. The government tried to ram through legislation. 政府试图强行通过立法。 | ram->公羊/撞击，ram through->像公羊冲撞一样强行推过 || 文化联想：中文“硬推过去”最适合帮助记忆 ram，可以说 **ram through a proposal — “A committee chair who ignores objections and forces an immediate vote may try to ram through a proposal.”**

quiz.question: ___ _____ diagram
quiz.explanation: 图表, 条形图. The presentation included a bar chart diagram. 演示文稿包括条形图。 | dia->穿过，gram->写/画，diagram->画出来的图=图表 || 文化联想：中国学生做物理和数学题时经常画示意图，最适合帮助记忆 diagram，可以说 **a simple diagram — “A physics student may draw a simple diagram to show forces acting on an object.”**

quiz.question: ____ anagram
quiz.explanation: 字谜, 单词字谜. Solving the word anagram required rearranging letters. 解决单词字谜需要重新排列字母。 | ana->重新，gram->字母，anagram->重新排列字母=字谜 || 文化联想：anagram 依赖字母重新排列，可用中国学生学英语时玩字母游戏来记忆，可以说 **an English anagram — “A Chinese learner of English may solve an anagram by rearranging the letters of one word to form another.”**

quiz.question: _____ epigram
quiz.explanation: 警句, 机智的警句. The author was famous for witty epigram. 作者以机智的警句而闻名。 | epi->在上面，gram->写，epigram->题刻在上面的话=警句 || 文化联想：中文“警句”最适合帮助记忆 epigram，可以说 **a concise epigram — “A short saying carved on a study wall may function like a concise epigram that expresses one memorable idea.”**

quiz.question: redeem ______
quiz.explanation: 兑换, 兑换优惠券. Customers can redeem coupon at checkout. 顾客可以在结账时兑换优惠券。 | re->回，deem->买回，redeem->买回=赎回/兑换 || 文化联想：美团、商场或电商结账时使用优惠券最适合帮助记忆 redeem，可以说 **redeem a coupon — “A shopper may redeem a coupon at checkout by scanning a code on the phone.”**

quiz.question: _______ stratagem
quiz.explanation: 计谋, 狡猾的计谋. The general devised a cunning stratagem. 将军设计了一个狡猾的计谋。 | strat->军队，agem->引导，stratagem->引导军队的手段=计谋 || 文化联想：《三十六计》最适合帮助记忆 stratagem，可以说 **a clever stratagem — “‘声东击西’ is a classic example of a clever stratagem that distracts an opponent from the real objective.”**

quiz.question: hem _ _____
quiz.explanation: 缝边, 给裙子缝边. The tailor will hem a skirt to the right length. 裁缝会把裙子缝边到合适的长度。 | hem->边缘/缝边，hem in->包围（围住边缘） || 文化联想：旗袍或裙子太长时裁缝会把下摆重新缝短，最适合帮助记忆 hem，可以说 **hem a skirt — “A tailor may hem a skirt so that its lower edge falls at the desired length.”**

quiz.question: ________ anthem
quiz.explanation: 国歌, 国歌. The crowd stood for the national anthem. 人群站立聆听国歌。 | anti->对，phon->声音，anthem->对唱的歌=颂歌/国歌 || 文化联想：升旗仪式奏国歌的场景最适合帮助记忆 anthem，可以说 **the national anthem — “At a formal flag-raising ceremony, the crowd stands while the national anthem is played.”**

quiz.question: _____ mayhem
quiz.explanation: 混乱, 城市混乱. The riot caused urban mayhem in the streets. 骚乱在街道上造成了城市混乱。 | maim->致残，mayhem->原指故意致残=蓄意破坏/大混乱 || 文化联想：春节大型景区突然涌入过多人群时一片混乱，最适合帮助记忆 mayhem，可以说 **crowd mayhem — “If barriers fail at an overcrowded festival, the orderly queue can quickly turn into crowd mayhem.”**

quiz.question: ____ apothegm
quiz.explanation: 格言, 智慧格言. The philosopher shared a wise apothegm. 哲学家分享了一句智慧格言。 | apo->离开，thegm->说话，apothegm->精炼说出的话=格言（cf. epigram警句） || 文化联想：中文“格言警句”最适合帮助记忆 apothegm，可以说 **a wise apothegm — “‘知足常乐’ is a compact saying that can be treated as a wise apothegm about contentment.”**

quiz.question: ________ paradigm
quiz.explanation: 范例, 教学范例. The school adopted a new teaching paradigm. 学校采用了新的教学范例。 | para->旁边，digm->展示，paradigm->展示给旁人看的=范例/典范 || 文化联想：中国学校从“老师讲、学生听”转向项目式学习时，就是教学范式变化，最适合帮助记忆 paradigm，可以说 **a teaching paradigm — “Project-based learning represents a different teaching paradigm from a classroom centered entirely on lectures and memorization.”**

quiz.question: ________ acclaim
quiz.explanation: 赞誉, 评论界赞誉. The film received critical acclaim from reviewers. 这部电影获得了评论界的赞誉。 | ac->朝向，claim->呼喊，acclaim->向某人呼喊喝彩=赞誉 || 文化联想：中国电影在国际电影节获得评论界广泛赞誉的场景最适合帮助记忆 acclaim，可以说 **critical acclaim — “A Chinese film praised by reviewers at home and abroad may receive widespread critical acclaim.”**

quiz.question: declaim ______
quiz.explanation: 朗诵, 朗诵诗歌. The actor would declaim poetry dramatically. 演员会戏剧性地朗诵诗歌。 | de->加强，claim->呼喊，declaim->大声呼喊=慷慨激昂地朗诵 || 文化联想：舞台上慷慨激昂朗诵李白《将进酒》最适合帮助记忆 declaim，可以说 **declaim poetry — “An actor may declaim poetry such as Li Bai’s ‘Bring in the Wine’ with a strong, dramatic voice.”**

quiz.question: reclaim ____
quiz.explanation: 开垦, 开垦土地. Engineers worked to reclaim land from the sea. 工程师努力从海中开垦土地。 | re->重新，claim->要回，reclaim->重新要回=开垦/回收 || 文化联想：中国沿海部分城市曾通过填海形成新的土地，最适合帮助记忆 reclaim，可以说 **reclaim land — “Engineers may reclaim land from shallow coastal water by filling and stabilizing the area.”**

quiz.question: disclaim ______________
quiz.explanation: 否认, 否认责任. The company tried to disclaim responsibility for damages. 公司试图否认对损害的责任。 | dis->否定，claim->声称，disclaim->否认声称=放弃/否认 || 文化联想：中文“甩锅、不认责任”最适合帮助记忆 disclaim，可以说 **disclaim responsibility — “A company that blames every failure on suppliers may try to disclaim responsibility—也就是‘甩锅.’”**

quiz.question: ____ whim
quiz.explanation: 突发奇想, 无聊的突发奇想. He made decisions on idle whim rather than planning. 他根据无聊的突发奇想而不是计划做决定。 | whim->突发奇想，whimsical->异想天开的 || 文化联想：中文“心血来潮”最适合帮助记忆 whim，可以说 **on a whim — “Someone may suddenly book a weekend trip to Hangzhou on a whim—因为一时‘心血来潮.’”**

quiz.question: denim ______
quiz.explanation: 牛仔布, 牛仔布夹克. She wore a classic denim jacket. 她穿着一件经典的牛仔布夹克。 | denim->来自法国Nîmes城的布料（de Nîmes->denim） || 文化联想：改革开放后牛仔裤和牛仔夹克逐渐成为常见休闲服装，最适合帮助记忆 denim，可以说 **a denim jacket — “A denim jacket became a familiar piece of casual clothing in Chinese cities as Western-style fashion spread.”**

quiz.question: _____ interim
quiz.explanation: 过渡期间, 短暂的过渡期间. There was a short interim between leaders. 领导人之间有一个短暂的过渡期间。 | inter->之间，im->进入，interim->在两者之间的时期=过渡期 || 文化联想：公司领导交接期间由临时负责人主持工作，最适合帮助记忆 interim，可以说 **an interim period — “During an interim period between two managers, a deputy may handle day-to-day decisions.”**

quiz.question: _________ pilgrim
quiz.explanation: 朝圣者, 宗教朝圣者. The religious pilgrim traveled to holy sites. 宗教朝圣者前往圣地。 | per->穿越，agri->田野，pilgrim->穿越田野的旅行者=朝圣者 || 文化联想：去五台山等佛教圣地朝拜的旅行者最适合帮助记忆 pilgrim，可以说 **a Buddhist pilgrim — “A Buddhist pilgrim may travel to Mount Wutai to visit temples, pray, and pay respects.”**

quiz.question: prim _______
quiz.explanation: 拘谨的, 拘谨的举止. The lady maintained prim manners at all times. 这位女士始终保持拘谨的举止。 | prim->最初/整洁，prim->过分整洁拘谨（cf. prime首要的） || 文化联想：中文“端着、过分拘谨”最适合帮助记忆 prim，可以说 **prim manners — “Someone sitting perfectly straight and speaking with excessive formality may display prim manners.”**

quiz.question: _____ verbatim
quiz.explanation: 逐字地, 逐字引用. Please quote verbatim from the original text. 请从原文逐字引用。 | verb->词/字，verbatim->逐字的（cf. verbal口头的） || 文化联想：中文“一字不差”最适合帮助记忆 verbatim，可以说 **quote verbatim — “A student citing a classical passage may be asked to quote it verbatim without changing a single word.”**

quiz.question: vim ___ _____
quiz.explanation: 精力, 精力和活力. The young athlete played with vim and vigor. 年轻运动员精力充沛地比赛。 | vim->力量（拉丁vis的宾格），vim and vigor->精力与活力 || 文化联想：龙舟队员奋力划桨、鼓点越敲越快的场面最适合帮助记忆 vim，可以说 **with vim and vigor — “A dragon-boat crew may paddle with vim and vigor as the drummer drives the rhythm.”**

quiz.question: _____ maxim
quiz.explanation: 格言, 道德格言. The teacher taught students a moral maxim. 老师向学生教授道德格言。 | max->最大，maxim->最高准则=格言（cf. maximum最大值） || 文化联想：“家和万事兴”最适合帮助记忆 maxim，可以说 **a family maxim — “‘家和万事兴’ is a familiar family maxim expressing the belief that harmony supports success.”**

quiz.question: ________ balm
quiz.explanation: 香膏, 舒缓香膏. The soothing balm relieved her dry skin. 舒缓香膏缓解了她的干燥皮肤。 | balm->香脂（balsam的缩写），balm->舒缓之物（cf. embalm防腐） || 文化联想：中国家庭常备清凉油、薄荷膏一类外用香膏，最适合帮助记忆 balm，可以说 **a soothing balm — “A small tin of soothing balm may be applied to dry or irritated skin for temporary comfort.”**

quiz.question: ___ realm __ ___
quiz.explanation: 领域, 艺术领域. His work explores the realm of art and science. 他的作品探索艺术和科学领域。 | real->王权，realm->王权管辖的范围=领域/王国 || 文化联想：中文“书画艺术领域”最适合帮助记忆 realm，可以说 **the realm of art — “Calligraphy occupies a special place in the realm of Chinese art because writing itself becomes visual expression.”**

quiz.question: ____ _ psalm
quiz.explanation: 赞美诗, 唱赞美诗. The congregation gathered to sing a psalm. 会众聚集唱赞美诗。 | psalm->弹拨乐器伴奏的歌（p不发音），psalm->赞美诗 || 文化联想：psalm 是犹太教和基督教的圣咏，可用中国教堂礼拜中唱诗的场景来记忆，可以说 **sing a psalm — “During worship in a church in China, a congregation may sing a psalm together.”**

quiz.question: _ ______ qualm
quiz.explanation: 疑虑, 突然的疑虑. She felt a sudden qualm about the decision. 她对这个决定感到突然的疑虑。 | qualm->恶心/良心不安（l不发音），qualm->突来的疑虑/不适 || 文化联想：中文“心里突然犯嘀咕”最适合帮助记忆 qualm，可以说 **a sudden qualm — “Just before signing an expensive contract, a buyer may feel a sudden qualm—心里突然‘犯嘀咕.’”**

quiz.question: elm ____
quiz.explanation: 榆树, 榆树. The old elm tree stood in the town square. 古老的榆树矗立在城镇广场上。 | elm->榆树（古英语），elm tree->榆树（著名如Elm Street榆树街） || 文化联想：中国北方村庄和城市街道也常见榆树，最适合帮助记忆 elm，可以说 **an elm tree — “An old elm tree may shade the entrance to a northern Chinese courtyard for decades.”**

quiz.question: ____ ___ helm
quiz.explanation: 舵, 掌舵. The new CEO will take the helm next month. 新任首席执行官将于下月掌舵。 | helm->舵/头盔（古英语），take the helm->掌舵=执掌领导权 || 文化联想：中文“掌舵”几乎就是 helm 的最佳联想，可以说 **take the helm — “When a new chief executive takes control of a company, we can say that the person takes the helm—开始‘掌舵.’”**

quiz.question: whelm ____ _____
quiz.explanation: 淹没, 被悲伤淹没. Sorrow seemed to whelm with grief. 悲伤似乎被悲痛淹没。 | whelm->淹没/翻覆，overwhelm->彻底淹没（over加强） || 文化联想：中文“被悲痛淹没”最适合帮助记忆 whelm，可以说 **be whelmed by grief — “After sudden bereavement, a person may feel whelmed by grief, as if sorrow were rising like water around them.”**

quiz.question: overwhelm ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 压倒, 压倒感官. The spectacular view would overwhelm the senses. 壮观的景色会压倒感官。 | over->超过，whelm->淹没，overwhelm->完全淹没=压倒 || 文化联想：春节庙会同时出现锣鼓、灯笼、香味和拥挤人群，最适合帮助记忆 overwhelm，可以说 **overwhelm the senses — “A crowded temple fair can overwhelm the senses with drums, bright lanterns, food aromas, and constant movement.”**

quiz.question: boredom _________
quiz.explanation: 无聊, 无聊阈值. Everyone has a different boredom threshold. 每个人都有不同的无聊阈值。 | bore->钻孔/令人厌烦，boredom->无聊状态（-dom表状态） || 文化联想：中文“无聊阈值很低”最适合帮助记忆 boredom，可以说 **a low boredom threshold — “Someone who checks the phone after only two quiet minutes may have a low boredom threshold.”**

quiz.question: ______ serfdom
quiz.explanation: 农奴制, 封建农奴制. The country abolished feudal serfdom centuries ago. 该国几个世纪前废除了封建农奴制。 | serf->农奴（拉丁servus奴隶），serfdom->农奴制度（-dom表制度） || 文化联想：serfdom 是欧洲等地区历史上的农奴制度，可用中国学生世界史课堂来记忆，可以说 **feudal serfdom — “In a world-history class, Chinese students may study feudal serfdom as a system that tied peasants to land and lords.”**

quiz.question: random ______
quiz.explanation: 随机的, 随机样本. Researchers selected a random sample for the study. 研究人员为研究选择了随机样本。 | random->奔跑/无方向（古法语），random->无规律的=随机的 || 文化联想：中国科研里“随机抽样”最适合帮助记忆 random，可以说 **a random sample — “A public-health survey may select a random sample of households so that every household has a fair chance of inclusion.”**

quiz.question: ____-_______ axiom
quiz.explanation: 公理, 不言而喻的公理. The declaration began with a self-evident axiom. 宣言以一个不言而喻的公理开始。 | axios->有价值（希腊），axiom->不需证明的真理=公理 || 文化联想：数学课里的“不证自明的基本命题”最适合帮助记忆 axiom，可以说 **a self-evident axiom — “In geometry, an axiom is accepted as a basic starting point from which later conclusions are derived.”**

quiz.question: ________ boom
quiz.explanation: 繁荣, 经济繁荣. The region experienced an economic boom. 该地区经历了经济繁荣。 | boom->爆炸声/激增，economic boom->经济爆炸式增长=经济繁荣 || 文化联想：深圳几十年快速发展最适合帮助记忆 boom，可以说 **an economic boom — “Rapid investment, manufacturing, and technology growth helped Shenzhen experience a remarkable economic boom.”**

quiz.question: ______ heirloom
quiz.explanation: 传家宝, 家族传家宝. The ring is a precious family heirloom. 这枚戒指是珍贵的家族传家宝。 | heir->继承人，loom->织机，heirloom->传给继承人的织机=传家宝 || 文化联想：中文“传家宝”几乎就是 heirloom 最直接的联想，可以说 **a family heirloom — “A jade bracelet passed from grandmother to granddaughter may become a treasured family heirloom.”**

quiz.question: _______ groom
quiz.explanation: 新郎, 婚礼新郎. The wedding groom nervously awaited his bride. 婚礼新郎紧张地等待他的新娘。 | groom->梳理/新郎，wedding groom->婚礼上被打扮好的男人=新郎 || 文化联想：中国婚礼里新郎迎亲、敬茶的场景最适合帮助记忆 groom，可以说 **the wedding groom — “At a Chinese wedding, the groom may join the bride in serving tea to elders as part of the ceremony.”**

quiz.question: _ maelstrom __
quiz.explanation: 大漩涡, 大漩涡. The scandal created a maelstrom of controversy. 丑闻引起了争议的大漩涡。 | mael->研磨，strom->流，maelstrom->旋转研磨的水流=大漩涡 || 文化联想：中文“舆论漩涡”最适合帮助记忆 maelstrom，可以说 **a maelstrom of controversy — “One viral accusation can pull a celebrity or company into a maelstrom of controversy online.”**

quiz.question: ___ ransom
quiz.explanation: 赎金, 支付赎金. The family refused to pay ransom to kidnappers. 家人拒绝向绑架者支付赎金。 | ransom->赎回（拉丁redemptio），ransom->赎金（cf. redeem赎回） || 文化联想：中文绑架题材警匪片里的“赎金”最适合帮助记忆 ransom，可以说 **pay a ransom — “In a crime drama, a kidnapped person’s family may be ordered to pay a ransom for the victim’s release.”**

quiz.question: phantom ____
quiz.explanation: 幻影, 幻肢. Amputees sometimes experience phantom limb sensations. 截肢者有时会经历幻肢感觉。 | phant->显现，phantom->显现之物=幻影（cf. fantastic幻想的） || 文化联想：现代医学里的“幻肢痛”最适合帮助记忆 phantom，可以说 **a phantom limb — “After an amputation, some patients can still feel sensations as if a phantom limb were present.”**

quiz.question: buxom ______
quiz.explanation: 丰满的, 丰满的身材. The painting depicted a woman with a buxom figure. 这幅画描绘了一个身材丰满的女人。 | buxom->柔顺/健壮（古英语），buxom->丰满健美的 || 文化联想：唐风仕女画常会描绘较丰润的女性形象，可用这种具体画面帮助记忆 buxom，可以说 **a buxom figure — “A modern painting inspired by Tang court ladies may depict a woman with a buxom figure and rounded features.”**

quiz.question: _____ charm
quiz.explanation: 魅力, 幸运符. She carried a lucky charm for good fortune. 她带着一个幸运符以求好运。 | charm->歌唱/咒语（拉丁carmen），charm->魅力/护身符 || 文化联想：中国庙会和寺庙周边常见“平安符”，最适合帮助记忆 charm，可以说 **a lucky charm — “A traveler may carry a small lucky charm or ‘平安符’ as a symbol of safety and good fortune.”**

quiz.question: disarm _________
quiz.explanation: 消除, 消除怀疑. His honest approach helped disarm suspicion. 他诚实的态度有助于消除怀疑。 | dis->去除，arm->武装，disarm->解除武装=消除（戒备/怀疑） || 文化联想：中文“坦诚解释，打消疑虑”最适合帮助记忆 disarm，可以说 **disarm suspicion — “A transparent explanation supported by receipts and records can help disarm suspicion.”**

quiz.question: lukewarm ________
quiz.explanation: 冷淡的, 冷淡的反应. The proposal received only a lukewarm response. 该提议只得到了冷淡的反应。 | luke->温热（古英语），warm->暖，lukewarm->微温=不冷不热=冷淡的 || 文化联想：中文“不冷不热”几乎就是 lukewarm 的直接联想，可以说 **a lukewarm response — “A proposal greeted with a few polite nods but no real enthusiasm receives a lukewarm response—‘不冷不热.’”**

quiz.question: germ ______
quiz.explanation: 细菌, 细菌理论. Pasteur developed the germ theory of disease. 巴斯德发展了疾病的细菌理论。 | germ->萌芽/种子，germ->病菌（最初指胚芽，后指致病微生物） || 文化联想：中国中学生物和卫生课都会学习病菌与传染病，最适合帮助记忆 germ，可以说 **the germ theory of disease — “Students learn that the germ theory of disease explains how microorganisms can cause many infections.”**

quiz.question: affirm ___ _______
quiz.explanation: 确认, 确认判决. The appeals court decided to affirm the verdict. 上诉法院决定确认判决。 | af->朝向，firm->坚定，affirm->使坚定=确认（cf. confirm再次确认） || 文化联想：现代上诉法院维持原判的场景最适合帮助记忆 affirm，可以说 **affirm the verdict — “If an appeals court finds no reversible error, it may affirm the verdict issued by the lower court.”**

quiz.question: infirm _______
quiz.explanation: 虚弱的, 虚弱的病人. The nurse cared for the infirm patient. 护士照顾虚弱的病人。 | in->否定，firm->坚强，infirm->不坚强的=虚弱的（cf. infirmary医务室） || 文化联想：中文“年老体弱”最适合帮助记忆 infirm，可以说 **an infirm patient — “A hospital may provide extra assistance to an infirm patient who has little strength and difficulty walking.”**

quiz.question: confirm ___________
quiz.explanation: 确认, 确认预订. Please call to confirm reservation for dinner. 请致电确认晚餐预订。 | con->共同，firm->坚定，confirm->共同坚定=确认 || 文化联想：中国餐厅订包间后打电话再次确认最适合帮助记忆 confirm，可以说 **confirm a reservation — “Before a family banquet, someone may call the restaurant to confirm a reservation for a private room.”**

quiz.question: ______ uniform
quiz.explanation: 制服, 校服. Students must wear school uniform daily. 学生必须每天穿校服。 | uni->一，form->形式，uniform->统一形式=制服/一致的 || 文化联想：中国学生每天穿统一校服最适合帮助记忆 uniform，可以说 **a school uniform — “Many Chinese students wear a school uniform during the school day.”**

quiz.question: misinform ___ ______
quiz.explanation: 误导, 误导公众. False news can misinform the public. 假新闻会误导公众。 | mis->错误，inform->告知，misinform->错误告知=误导 || 文化联想：中文“谣言误导公众”最适合帮助记忆 misinform，可以说 **misinform the public — “A false post repeated thousands of times can misinform the public unless reliable evidence corrects it.”**

quiz.question: conform __ _____
quiz.explanation: 遵守, 遵守规范. Society expects individuals to conform to norms. 社会期望个人遵守规范。 | con->共同，form->形式，conform->与共同形式一致=遵守 || 文化联想：中文“入乡随俗”最适合帮助记忆 conform，可以说 **conform to local norms — “A visitor who follows local customs and etiquette is choosing to conform to local norms—‘入乡随俗.’”**

quiz.question: ______ norm
quiz.explanation: 规范, 社会规范. Breaking social norm can lead to disapproval. 违反社会规范可能会导致不认可。 | norm->标准/正常（拉丁norma->直角尺），normal->正常的 || 文化联想：中文“社会约定俗成的规矩”最适合帮助记忆 norm，可以说 **a social norm — “Giving up one’s seat to an elderly passenger is widely treated as a social norm in many Chinese cities.”**

quiz.question: ______ ostracism
quiz.explanation: 排斥, 社会排斥. The whistleblower faced social ostracism. 告密者面临社会排斥。 | ostracon->陶片（古希腊用陶片投票放逐），ostracism->放逐/排斥 || 文化联想：中文“被圈子排斥”最适合帮助记忆 ostracism，可以说 **social ostracism — “A student deliberately excluded from every group activity may experience social ostracism.”**

quiz.question: _______ empiricism
quiz.explanation: 经验主义, 医学经验主义. Medical empiricism relies on observation and experience. 医学经验主义依赖观察和经验。 | empiri->经验，empiricism->以经验为基础的主义 || 文化联想：“实践出真知”最适合帮助记忆 empiricism，可以说 **medical empiricism — “The idea that repeated observation and clinical experience matter reflects medical empiricism—‘实践出真知.’”**

quiz.question: ________ eclecticism
quiz.explanation: 折衷主义, 文学折衷主义. The author's style showed literary eclecticism. 作者的风格显示出文学折衷主义。 | ec->从中，lect->选择，eclecticism->从各处选取精华=折衷主义 || 文化联想：中文“兼收并蓄”最适合帮助记忆 eclecticism，可以说 **literary eclecticism — “A writer who draws on classical prose, modern fiction, and foreign techniques may display literary eclecticism.”**

quiz.question: witticism ______
quiz.explanation: 妙语, 大量妙语. His speech contained witticism galore. 他的演讲包含大量妙语。 | wit->机智，witticism->机智说出的话=妙语 || 文化联想：相声演员一句接一句抛出机智包袱，最适合帮助记忆 witticism，可以说 **witticism galore — “A sharp xiangsheng routine may contain witticism galore, with clever lines appearing every few seconds.”**

quiz.question: _______ absenteeism
quiz.explanation: 旷工, 长期旷工. The company struggled with chronic absenteeism. 公司与长期旷工作斗争。 | absent->缺席，absenteeism->习惯性缺席=旷工 || 文化联想：中文职场里的“长期旷工”最适合帮助记忆 absenteeism，可以说 **chronic absenteeism — “An employee who repeatedly fails to show up for work without good reason may develop a record of chronic absenteeism.”**

quiz.question: atheism ______
quiz.explanation: 无神论, 无神论辩论. The atheism debate continued for hours. 无神论辩论持续了数小时。 | a->否定，theos->神，atheism->否定神存在的主义=无神论 || 文化联想：中国大学哲学课讨论“有没有神”最适合帮助记忆 atheism，可以说 **an atheism debate — “A philosophy seminar may hold an atheism debate about whether belief in a deity is rationally justified.”**

quiz.question: ____ neologism
quiz.explanation: 新词, 科技新词. Social media created many tech neologism. 社交媒体创造了许多科技新词。 | neo->新，log->词，neologism->新造的词=新词 || 文化联想：中文互联网不断造出“内卷”“躺平”等新词，最适合帮助记忆 neologism，可以说 **a popular neologism — “‘内卷’ became a popular neologism used to describe exhausting competition with little real gain.”**

quiz.question: _____ schism
quiz.explanation: 分裂, 政党分裂. A party schism divided the organization. 政党分裂分裂了组织。 | schiz->切开（cf. schizophrenia精神分裂），schism->切开=分裂 || 文化联想：中国历史上党派内部出现严重路线分歧的场景最适合帮助记忆 schism，可以说 **a party schism — “A bitter dispute over strategy can create a party schism that splits former allies into rival camps.”**

quiz.question: sophism ____
quiz.explanation: 诡辩, 诡辩陷阱. The argument was a clever sophism trap. 这个论点是一个巧妙的诡辩陷阱。 | sophos->智慧（希腊），sophism->貌似智慧实为狡猾的论证=诡辩 || 文化联想：中文“偷换概念”最适合帮助记忆 sophism，可以说 **a sophism trap — “An argument that quietly changes the meaning of a key term can become a sophism trap—类似中文所说的‘偷换概念.’”**

quiz.question: surrealism ___
quiz.explanation: 超现实主义, 超现实主义艺术. Dali was a master of surrealism art. 达利是超现实主义艺术的大师。 | sur->超越，real->现实，surrealism->超越现实的艺术主义 || 文化联想：中国美术学院学生学习达利等作品时最适合帮助记忆 surrealism，可以说 **surrealism in art — “A Chinese art student may study surrealism in art through dreamlike images that deliberately defy ordinary reality.”**

quiz.question: ___________ parallelism
quiz.explanation: 平行, 语法平行. The sentence lacked grammatical parallelism. 这个句子缺乏语法平行。 | para->旁边，allel->彼此，parallelism->结构彼此并排=平行 || 文化联想：对联讲究上下句结构对应，最适合帮助记忆 parallelism，可以说 **grammatical parallelism — “A well-made Chinese couplet often relies on grammatical parallelism between the upper and lower lines.”**

quiz.question: pugilism _____
quiz.explanation: 拳击, 拳击比赛. The championship pugilism match drew crowds. 冠军拳击比赛吸引了人群。 | pugil->拳击手（拉丁pugnus->拳头），pugilism->拳击运动 || 文化联想：现代中国拳击比赛最适合帮助记忆 pugilism，可以说 **a pugilism match — “A traditional sports writer might call a championship boxing contest a pugilism match.”**

quiz.question: _____________ nihilism
quiz.explanation: 虚无主义, 哲学虚无主义. Nietzsche explored philosophical nihilism. 尼采探索了哲学虚无主义。 | nihil->虚无（拉丁），nihilism->一切皆虚无的主义 || 文化联想：中文青年讨论“人生毫无意义”时最适合帮助记忆 nihilism，可以说 **philosophical nihilism — “A student who concludes that life has no meaning or value may be attracted to philosophical nihilism.”**

quiz.question: ______ euphemism
quiz.explanation: 委婉语, 礼貌的委婉语. Passed away is a polite euphemism for died. 去世是死亡的礼貌委婉语。 | eu->好，phem->说，euphemism->说得好听=委婉语 || 文化联想：中文常用“去世”代替直接说“死”，最适合帮助记忆 euphemism，可以说 **a polite euphemism — “‘去世’ is a polite euphemism for death because it softens a harsh reality.”**

quiz.question: ____ pessimism
quiz.explanation: 悲观主义, 深度悲观主义. The crisis generated deep pessimism. 危机产生了深度悲观主义。 | pessim->最坏（拉丁），pessimism->认为事情最坏的主义（cf. optimism乐观主义） || 文化联想：经济低迷时社会情绪普遍悲观，最适合帮助记忆 pessimism，可以说 **deep pessimism — “A long recession can produce deep pessimism about jobs, housing, and the future.”**

quiz.question: _______ optimism
quiz.explanation: 乐观主义, 谨慎的乐观主义. Officials expressed guarded optimism about recovery. 官员对复苏表示谨慎的乐观。 | optim->最好（拉丁），optimism->认为事情最好的主义 || 文化联想：中文“谨慎乐观”最适合帮助记忆 optimism，可以说 **guarded optimism — “After several months of improvement, officials may express guarded optimism rather than declare victory too early.”**

quiz.question: ______ organism
quiz.explanation: 有机体, 生物有机体. Every living organism requires water. 每个生物有机体都需要水。 | organ->器官/组织，organism->有器官组织的生命体 || 文化联想：大熊猫是中国最熟悉的大型生物之一，最适合帮助记忆 organism，可以说 **a living organism — “A giant panda is a living organism that needs food, water, oxygen, and a suitable habitat.”**

quiz.question: microorganism ______
quiz.explanation: 微生物, 微生物生长. Temperature affects microorganism growth. 温度影响微生物生长。 | micro->微小，organism->有机体，microorganism->微小的有机体=微生物 || 文化联想：中国实验室培养细菌、酵母等微生物最适合帮助记忆 microorganism，可以说 **microorganism growth — “Temperature and nutrients can strongly affect microorganism growth in a laboratory culture.”**

quiz.question: _______ mechanism
quiz.explanation: 机制, 防御机制. Denial is a common defense mechanism. 否认是一种常见的防御机制。 | mechan->机械，mechanism->运作方式=机制（cf. machine机器） || 文化联想：中文“自我防卫机制”最适合帮助记忆 mechanism，可以说 **a defense mechanism — “Someone who refuses to admit an obvious mistake may be using denial as a defense mechanism.”**

quiz.question: cosmopolitanism _____
quiz.explanation: 世界主义, 世界主义理想. The city embodied the cosmopolitanism ideal. 这座城市体现了世界主义理想。 | cosmo->世界，polit->城邦，cosmopolitanism->全球城邦公民理想=世界主义 || 文化联想：上海长期吸收各地和海外人口的城市气质很适合帮助记忆 cosmopolitanism，可以说 **urban cosmopolitanism — “Shanghai’s mixture of local traditions and global influences reflects a strong form of urban cosmopolitanism.”**

quiz.question: _____ chauvinism
quiz.explanation: 沙文主义, 狂热的沙文主义. His rabid chauvinism alienated colleagues. 他狂热的沙文主义疏远了同事。 | Chauvin->法国极端爱国军人，chauvinism->极端民族优越感=沙文主义 || 文化联想：中文“极端民族优越感”最适合帮助记忆 chauvinism，可以说 **rabid chauvinism — “Treating one’s own nation as inherently superior to all others can turn patriotism into rabid chauvinism.”**

quiz.question: ____-_________ hedonism
quiz.explanation: 享乐主义, 自我放纵的享乐主义. The lifestyle represented self-indulgent hedonism. 这种生活方式代表了自我放纵的享乐主义。 | hedone->快乐（希腊），hedonism->以追求快乐为最高目标的主义 || 文化联想：《金瓶梅》中沉迷享乐的生活方式最适合帮助记忆 hedonism，可以说 **self-indulgent hedonism — “A life devoted entirely to luxury, drinking, and sensual pleasure can become self-indulgent hedonism.”**

quiz.question: ____ antagonism
quiz.explanation: 对抗, 公开对抗. There was open antagonism between the rivals. 对手之间存在公开对抗。 | anti->对抗，agon->竞争，antagonism->相互竞争对抗 || 文化联想：中文“针锋相对”最适合帮助记忆 antagonism，可以说 **open antagonism — “Two factions that attack each other at every meeting display open antagonism—‘针锋相对.’”**

quiz.question: _______ egoism
quiz.explanation: 利己主义, 自私的利己主义. His behavior showed selfish egoism. 他的行为表现出自私的利己主义。 | ego->自我（拉丁），egoism->以自我为中心的主义（cf. egotism自大） || 文化联想：中文“凡事只顾自己”最适合帮助记忆 egoism，可以说 **selfish egoism — “A person who considers only personal gain and ignores everyone else may show selfish egoism.”**

quiz.question: jingoism ________
quiz.explanation: 沙文主义, 沙文主义言辞. Political speeches used jingoism rhetoric. 政治演讲使用了沙文主义言辞。 | jingo->19世纪英国好战歌词中的语气词，jingoism->好战的极端爱国主义 || 文化联想：中文“好战式极端爱国言辞”最适合帮助记忆 jingoism，可以说 **jingoism rhetoric — “A speech demanding confrontation simply to prove national toughness is full of jingoism rhetoric.”**

quiz.question: escapism _______
quiz.explanation: 逃避主义, 逃避主义幻想. The novel offered escapism fantasy from reality. 小说提供了逃避现实的逃避主义幻想。 | escape->逃跑，escapism->通过幻想逃避现实的倾向 || 文化联想：刷短视频、追爽剧暂时逃避现实压力的场景最适合帮助记忆 escapism，可以说 **escapism fantasy — “A highly immersive drama may provide escapism fantasy for viewers who want a temporary break from real-life stress.”**

quiz.question: _____ malapropism
quiz.explanation: 词语误用, 滑稽的词语误用. The character's speech was full of comic malapropism. 这个角色的演讲充满了滑稽的词语误用。 | mal->错误，à propos->恰当，malapropism->用错相似词=词语误用 || 文化联想：中文相声里故意把相近词说错制造笑料，很适合联想到 malapropism，可以说 **a comic malapropism — “A performer who confuses two similar-sounding words on purpose may create a comic malapropism.”**

quiz.question: plagiarism ____
quiz.explanation: 抄袭, 抄袭案件. The university investigated the plagiarism case. 大学调查了抄袭案件。 | plagiarius->诱拐者（拉丁），plagiarism->偷窃他人思想=抄袭 || 文化联想：中文“论文抄袭”最适合帮助记忆 plagiarism，可以说 **a plagiarism case — “Copying paragraphs from another thesis without citation can trigger a serious plagiarism case at a university.”**

quiz.question: ________ mesmerism
quiz.explanation: 催眠术, 实践催眠术. The doctor would practice mesmerism on patients. 医生会对病人实践催眠术。 | Mesmer->18世纪医生Franz Mesmer，mesmerism->由他发明的催眠术 || 文化联想：mesmerism 是西方催眠术史概念，可用中国心理学史课堂来记忆，可以说 **the practice of mesmerism — “A history-of-psychology class in China may discuss the practice of mesmerism as an early precursor to modern hypnosis.”**

quiz.question: _____ aphorism
quiz.explanation: 格言, 简洁的格言. Franklin was known for pithy aphorism. 富兰克林以简洁的格言而闻名。 | apo->离开，hori->界定，aphorism->划定界限的话=格言（cf. apothegm格言） || 文化联想：中文“良药苦口”这种短小有力的格言最适合帮助记忆 aphorism，可以说 **a pithy aphorism — “‘良药苦口’ is a pithy aphorism expressing the idea that useful advice may be unpleasant to hear.”**

quiz.question: _____ dogmatism
quiz.explanation: 教条主义, 僵化的教条主义. His rigid dogmatism prevented compromise. 他僵化的教条主义阻止了妥协。 | dogma->教义，dogmatism->固守教义不变通=教条主义 || 文化联想：中文“死抱教条”最适合帮助记忆 dogmatism，可以说 **rigid dogmatism — “Refusing to adjust a rule even after clear evidence shows it does not work is rigid dogmatism—‘死抱教条.’”**

quiz.question: patriotism ______
quiz.explanation: 爱国主义, 爱国主义精神. The holiday celebrates patriotism spirit. 这个节日庆祝爱国主义精神。 | patri->父亲/祖国，patriotism->热爱祖国的情感=爱国主义 || 文化联想：升旗仪式中对国家的尊重最适合帮助记忆 patriotism，可以说 **a spirit of patriotism — “Standing solemnly during a national flag ceremony can express a spirit of patriotism.”**

quiz.question: _________ nepotism
quiz.explanation: 裙带关系, 无耻的裙带关系. The leader practiced shameless nepotism. 领导人实行无耻的裙带关系。 | nepos->侄子（拉丁，教皇任命侄子为要职），nepotism->任人唯亲 || 文化联想：中文“任人唯亲”最适合帮助记忆 nepotism，可以说 **shameless nepotism — “A leader who gives important jobs to unqualified relatives practices shameless nepotism—‘任人唯亲.’”**

quiz.question: ___________ despotism
quiz.explanation: 专制, 开明专制. The ruler claimed to practice enlightened despotism. 统治者声称实行开明专制。 | despotes->主人（希腊），despotism->主人独掌一切=专制 || 文化联想：中国学生世界史课学习“开明专制”最适合帮助记忆 despotism，可以说 **enlightened despotism — “In a world-history class, students may study enlightened despotism as rule by an absolute monarch who still pursues selected reforms.”**

quiz.question: _____ truism
quiz.explanation: 陈词滥调, 陈腐的陈词滥调. The speech repeated tired truism. 演讲重复了陈腐的陈词滥调。 | true->真实，truism->人人皆知的真理=陈词滥调 || 文化联想：中文“老生常谈”最适合帮助记忆 truism，可以说 **a tired truism — “Repeating ‘young people should work hard’ without adding any insight can sound like a tired truism—‘老生常谈.’”**

quiz.question: ____ altruism
quiz.explanation: 利他主义, 纯粹的利他主义. Her actions demonstrated pure altruism. 她的行为展示了纯粹的利他主义。 | altr->他人（拉丁alter），altruism->为他人着想的主义（cf. egoism利己主义） || 文化联想：“毫不利己，专门利人”的理想形象最适合帮助记忆 altruism，可以说 **pure altruism — “Helping a stranger at great personal cost with no expectation of reward comes close to pure altruism.”**

quiz.question: cronyism _______
quiz.explanation: 任人唯亲, 任人唯亲丑闻. The mayor was embroiled in a cronyism scandal. 市长卷入了任人唯亲丑闻。 | crony->老朋友，cronyism->提拔老朋友的做法=任人唯亲（cf. nepotism裙带关系） || 文化联想：中文“任用自己的哥们儿”最适合帮助记忆 cronyism，可以说 **a cronyism scandal — “A mayor who gives contracts and positions to old friends may become embroiled in a cronyism scandal.”**

quiz.question: ______ cataclysm
quiz.explanation: 大灾难, 全球大灾难. Climate change could trigger a global cataclysm. 气候变化可能引发全球大灾难。 | cata->向下，clysm->洪水，cataclysm->大洪水般的灾难 || 文化联想：中文“天塌地陷般的大灾难”最适合帮助记忆 cataclysm，可以说 **a global cataclysm — “A massive asteroid impact would be a global cataclysm capable of transforming climate and ecosystems.”**

quiz.question: _ modicum __ _____
quiz.explanation: 少量, 少量真相. There was a modicum of truth in the rumor. 谣言中有少量真相。 | mod->适度，modicum->适度的少量（cf. moderate适中） || 文化联想：中文“有那么一点道理”最适合帮助记忆 modicum，可以说 **a modicum of truth — “Even an exaggerated rumor may contain a modicum of truth—也就是‘有那么一点道理.’”**

quiz.question: ________ addendum
quiz.explanation: 附录, 合同附录. The lawyer prepared a contract addendum. 律师准备了合同附录。 | add->加入，addendum->需要加入的东西=附录（复数addenda） || 文化联想：现代中国合同补充协议最适合帮助记忆 addendum，可以说 **a contract addendum — “When two parties change one term after signing, they may record the change in a contract addendum.”**

quiz.question: linoleum _____
quiz.explanation: 油毡, 油毡地板. The kitchen had a linoleum floor. 厨房有油毡地板。 | lino->亚麻，oleum->油，linoleum->亚麻油制成的地板材料=油毡 || 文化联想：上世纪学校、医院或老住宅常见油毡地面，最适合帮助记忆 linoleum，可以说 **a linoleum floor — “An older apartment may still have a linoleum floor in the kitchen because the material is easy to clean.”**

quiz.question: petroleum ________
quiz.explanation: 石油, 石油炼油厂. The petroleum refinery operated twenty-four hours. 石油炼油厂二十四小时运营。 | petra->岩石，oleum->油，petroleum->岩石中的油=石油 || 文化联想：大庆、独山子等石化产业最适合帮助记忆 petroleum，可以说 **a petroleum refinery — “A petroleum refinery processes crude oil into fuels and other chemical products.”**

quiz.question: calcium ______
quiz.explanation: 钙, 钙摄入量. Doctors recommend adequate calcium intake. 医生建议充足的钙摄入量。 | calx->石灰（拉丁），calcium->石灰中提取的金属元素=钙 || 文化联想：中国人常通过牛奶、豆制品补钙，最适合帮助记忆 calcium，可以说 **adequate calcium intake — “Milk, tofu, and some leafy vegetables can help support adequate calcium intake.”**

quiz.question: medium __ ________
quiz.explanation: 媒介, 交换媒介. Money serves as a medium of exchange. 货币作为交换媒介。 | medi->中间，medium->中间物=媒介（cf. medieval中世纪，intermediate中间的） || 文化联想：人民币作为交易媒介最适合帮助记忆 medium，可以说 **a medium of exchange — “Money functions as a medium of exchange because buyers and sellers accept it in transactions.”**

quiz.question: ____-_______ tedium
quiz.explanation: 乏味, 令人麻木的乏味. The work involved mind-numbing tedium. 工作涉及令人麻木的乏味。 | taed->厌烦（拉丁），tedium->令人厌烦的状态（cf. tedious乏味的） || 文化联想：中文“枯燥到麻木”最适合帮助记忆 tedium，可以说 **mind-numbing tedium — “Copying the same numbers into hundreds of rows can become mind-numbing tedium.”**

quiz.question: _______ compendium
quiz.explanation: 纲要, 简明纲要. The book is a concise compendium of facts. 这本书是事实的简明纲要。 | com->共同，pend->称重，compendium->称量汇总的要点=纲要 || 文化联想：《四库全书》这种大型汇编最适合帮助记忆 compendium，可以说 **a historical compendium — “A carefully organized reference work collecting information from many sources can serve as a historical compendium.”**

quiz.question: ______ odium
quiz.explanation: 憎恶, 公众憎恶. The scandal brought public odium upon him. 丑闻给他带来了公众憎恶。 | odi->恨（拉丁odi=I hate），odium->被众人憎恨（cf. odious可憎的） || 文化联想：中文“臭名昭著、万人唾骂”最适合帮助记忆 odium，可以说 **public odium — “A corrupt official exposed for stealing disaster-relief funds may attract intense public odium.”**

quiz.question: _____ podium
quiz.explanation: 领奖台, 领奖台. The athlete stood on the award podium. 运动员站在领奖台上。 | pod->脚（希腊），podium->脚下的台子=讲台/领奖台（cf. tripod三脚架） || 文化联想：中国运动员站上领奖台最适合帮助记忆 podium，可以说 **an award podium — “After winning a race, an athlete may stand on the award podium to receive a medal.”**

quiz.question: premium _______
quiz.explanation: 优质的, 优质品质. The company offers premium quality products. 公司提供优质品质产品。 | pre->之前/最先，em->取得，premium->最先取得的奖励=优质/溢价 || 文化联想：高端茶叶或白酒常以“优质”作为卖点，最适合帮助记忆 premium，可以说 **premium quality — “A brand may charge more for tea marketed as premium quality because of origin, processing, and grading.”**

quiz.question: __________ encomium
quiz.explanation: 赞颂, 奉承的赞颂. The speaker delivered a flattering encomium. 演讲者发表了奉承的赞颂。 | en->在内，comium->游行/庆典（希腊komos），encomium->庆典中的赞颂 || 文化联想：传统祭文或悼词中过度赞颂逝者的场景最适合帮助记忆 encomium，可以说 **a flattering encomium — “A memorial speech that praises every aspect of a powerful official’s life may become a flattering encomium.”**

quiz.question: _ ___ millennium
quiz.explanation: 千年, 新千年. We celebrate the beginning of a new millennium. 我们庆祝新千年的开始。 | mille->千，annum->年，millennium->一千年（cf. centennial百年） || 文化联想：中文“千年古都”最适合帮助记忆 millennium，可以说 **a new millennium — “Xi’an has witnessed political and cultural change across more than one millennium of recorded history.”**

quiz.question: _____ pandemonium
quiz.explanation: 大混乱, 完全混乱. The announcement caused total pandemonium. 这一公告引起了完全混乱。 | pan->全部，demon->恶魔，pandemonium->所有恶魔聚集=大混乱 || 文化联想：春运车站人群失控、广播不断、行李堆满通道的场景最适合帮助记忆 pandemonium，可以说 **total pandemonium — “If trains are suddenly canceled during the travel rush, a crowded station can descend into total pandemonium.”**

quiz.question: ___ honorarium
quiz.explanation: 酬金, 支付酬金. The university will pay honorarium to guest speakers. 大学将向客座演讲者支付酬金。 | honor->荣誉，honorarium->以荣誉之名支付的酬劳=酬金 || 文化联想：中国大学请专家做讲座有时会支付讲课费，最适合帮助记忆 honorarium，可以说 **an honorarium payment — “A university may give a visiting scholar an honorarium payment after a public lecture.”**

quiz.question: ______ equilibrium
quiz.explanation: 平衡, 市场平衡. Supply and demand reach market equilibrium. 供求达到市场平衡。 | equi->相等，libr->秤，equilibrium->秤两端相等=平衡（cf. equilateral等边） || 文化联想：太极图阴阳相济的文化形象最适合帮助记忆 equilibrium，可以说 **a state of equilibrium — “The yin-yang symbol is often used to represent a state of equilibrium between opposing but complementary forces.”**

quiz.question: ______ bacterium
quiz.explanation: 细菌, 单个细菌. A single bacterium can multiply rapidly. 单个细菌可以迅速繁殖。 | bacter->小棒（希腊，形似棒状），bacterium->细菌（复数bacteria） || 文化联想：中国中学生物课里乳酸菌最适合帮助记忆 bacterium，可以说 **a single bacterium — “A single bacterium can multiply rapidly under favorable conditions and form a large colony.”**

quiz.question: delirium _______
quiz.explanation: 谵妄, 震颤性谵妄. Alcohol withdrawal can cause delirium tremens. 酒精戒断会引起震颤性谵妄。 | de->偏离，lira->轨道，delirium->偏离正轨=神志错乱/谵妄 || 文化联想：白酒成瘾者突然停酒后可能出现震颤谵妄，是 delirium 的医学场景，可以说 **delirium tremens — “A person with severe alcohol dependence may develop delirium tremens after suddenly stopping drinking.”**

quiz.question: ________ sanatorium
quiz.explanation: 疗养院, 山间疗养院. The patient recovered at a mountain sanatorium. 患者在山间疗养院康复。 | san->健康，sanatorium->使人恢复健康的地方=疗养院（cf. sanitary卫生的） || 文化联想：庐山、莫干山旧时疗养院最适合帮助记忆 sanatorium，可以说 **a mountain sanatorium — “In the early twentieth century, a mountain sanatorium might be built in a cool climate for long-term rest and recovery.”**

quiz.question: ____ moratorium
quiz.explanation: 暂停, 贷款暂停. The bank declared a loan moratorium. 银行宣布贷款暂停。 | mora->延迟（拉丁），moratorium->官方批准的延迟=暂停（cf. morass泥沼） || 文化联想：房贷暂缓还款政策最适合帮助记忆 moratorium，可以说 **a loan moratorium — “After a major disaster, banks may offer a temporary loan moratorium so affected families can postpone payments.”**

quiz.question: ______ auditorium
quiz.explanation: 礼堂, 学校礼堂. The concert was held in the school auditorium. 音乐会在学校礼堂举行。 | audit->听，auditorium->供人聆听的场所=礼堂（cf. audience观众） || 文化联想：中国学校的大礼堂最适合帮助记忆 auditorium，可以说 **a school auditorium — “Students may gather in a school auditorium for performances, speeches, and major ceremonies.”**

quiz.question: ________ symposium
quiz.explanation: 研讨会, 学术研讨会. Scholars presented papers at the academic symposium. 学者在学术研讨会上提交论文。 | sym->共同，posium->饮酒，symposium->共饮畅谈=研讨会（古希腊饮酒讨论会） || 文化联想：高校举办学术研讨会最适合帮助记忆 symposium，可以说 **an academic symposium — “A university may host an academic symposium where scholars present research and debate a specialized topic.”**

quiz.question: ________ colloquium
quiz.explanation: 学术讨论会, 学术讨论会. The professor hosted an academic colloquium. 教授主持了学术讨论会。 | col->共同，loqu->说话，colloquium->共同说话=学术讨论会（cf. colloquial口语的） || 文化联想：中文“学术座谈会”最适合帮助记忆 colloquium，可以说 **an academic colloquium — “A department may organize an academic colloquium where faculty and graduate students discuss current research.”**

quiz.question: ______ curriculum
quiz.explanation: 课程, 学校课程. The school curriculum includes math and science. 学校课程包括数学和科学。 | curr->跑，curriculum->跑完的赛程=课程（cf. current水流，race赛跑） || 文化联想：中国中小学“课程设置”最适合帮助记忆 curriculum，可以说 **a school curriculum — “A school curriculum may include Chinese, mathematics, English, science, physical education, and art.”**

quiz.question: ________ pendulum
quiz.explanation: 钟摆, 摆动的钟摆. The swinging pendulum measured time. 摆动的钟摆测量时间。 | pend->悬挂，pendulum->悬挂摆动的东西=钟摆（cf. pendant挂件，depend依赖） || 文化联想：寺庙大钟或老式挂钟来回摆动的钟摆最适合帮助记忆 pendulum，可以说 **a swinging pendulum — “A large mechanical clock works as a swinging pendulum moves back and forth at a steady rhythm.”**

quiz.question: _________ asylum
quiz.explanation: 庇护, 政治庇护. The refugee sought political asylum. 难民寻求政治庇护。 | a->无，sylum->抓取（希腊），asylum->不可被抓取的地方=庇护所 || 文化联想：近代中国也曾接收因政治原因避难的人士，可用这种现代国际语境帮助记忆 asylum，可以说 **political asylum — “A dissident who fears persecution may apply for political asylum in another country.”**

quiz.question: _____ chrysanthemum
quiz.explanation: 菊花, 白菊花. The garden featured beautiful white chrysanthemum. 花园里有美丽的白菊花。 | chryso->金，anthemum->花，chrysanthemum->金色的花=菊花 || 文化联想：陶渊明“采菊东篱下”最适合帮助记忆 chrysanthemum，可以说 **a yellow chrysanthemum — “The line ‘picking chrysanthemums by the eastern fence’ makes the yellow chrysanthemum an enduring image of Tao Yuanming’s poetry.”**

quiz.question: optimum _____
quiz.explanation: 最佳的, 最佳水平. The machine operates at optimum level. 机器在最佳水平运行。 | optim->最好，optimum->最佳状态（cf. optimism乐观主义，maximum最大值） || 文化联想：中文“最佳状态”最适合帮助记忆 optimum，可以说 **the optimum level — “A greenhouse must maintain the optimum level of temperature and moisture for a particular crop.”**

quiz.question: _____ interregnum
quiz.explanation: 空位期, 权力空位期. A power interregnum followed the king's death. 国王去世后出现了权力空位期。 | inter->之间，regnum->统治，interregnum->两次统治之间的空档=空位期 || 文化联想：中国王朝皇位空缺、继承未定的短暂时期最适合帮助记忆 interregnum，可以说 **a brief interregnum — “After an emperor dies before a successor is securely established, the court may pass through a brief interregnum.”**

quiz.question: ____ ___ fulcrum
quiz.explanation: 支点, 找到支点. Engineers must find the fulcrum for the lever. 工程师必须为杠杆找到支点。 | fulc->支撑，fulcrum->支撑杠杆的点=支点（cf. fulcrum在政治中指关键支撑点） || 文化联想：“四两拨千斤”里的支点概念最适合帮助记忆 fulcrum，可以说 **find the fulcrum — “A lever can move a heavy load more effectively once you find the fulcrum and place it correctly.”**

quiz.question: humdrum _______
quiz.explanation: 单调的, 单调的例行公事. Workers tired of the humdrum routine. 工人厌倦了单调的例行公事。 | hum->哼哼，drum->鼓声，humdrum->像鼓声一样重复的=单调乏味 || 文化联想：中文“日复一日的平淡生活”最适合帮助记忆 humdrum，可以说 **a humdrum routine — “Commuting, answering email, eating dinner, and repeating the same schedule can become a humdrum routine.”**

quiz.question: _____ _ conundrum
quiz.explanation: 难题, 解决难题. The detective tried to solve a conundrum. 侦探试图解决难题。 | conundrum->来源不明的戏谑词，今指令人困惑的难题/谜题 || 文化联想：中文“左右为难的难题”最适合帮助记忆 conundrum，可以说 **solve a conundrum — “A city trying to lower housing costs without reducing supply must solve a difficult conundrum.”**

quiz.question: ____ decorum
quiz.explanation: 礼仪, 表现礼仪. Guests were expected to show decorum. 客人被期望表现礼仪。 | decor->装饰/得体，decorum->得体的行为举止=礼仪（cf. decorate装饰） || 文化联想：中文“有礼有节”最适合帮助记忆 decorum，可以说 **show decorum — “At a solemn ancestral ceremony, participants are expected to show decorum in speech and behavior.”**

quiz.question: ______ forum
quiz.explanation: 论坛, 在线论坛. Users discussed issues in the online forum. 用户在在线论坛讨论问题。 | forum->罗马广场（公共讨论场所），forum->论坛（cf. forensic法庭的） || 文化联想：中文“网上论坛”最适合帮助记忆 forum，可以说 **an online forum — “An online forum allows users to ask questions, exchange advice, and debate topics in public threads.”**

quiz.question: _____ spectrum
quiz.explanation: 光谱, 色谱. The prism revealed the color spectrum. 棱镜显示了色谱。 | spect->看，spectrum->可见的范围=光谱（cf. inspect检查，spectacle奇观） || 文化联想：中国京剧脸谱颜色从红到黑、白形成鲜明色彩范围，最适合帮助记忆 spectrum，可以说 **a broad color spectrum — “Peking-opera makeup uses a broad color spectrum to distinguish different character types and symbolic traits.”**

quiz.question: _______ nostrum
quiz.explanation: 秘方, 神奇秘方. The salesman peddled a miracle nostrum. 推销员兜售神奇秘方。 | nostr->我们的（拉丁），nostrum->我们自己的秘方=万能药/秘方 || 文化联想：中文“包治百病的神药”最适合帮助记忆 nostrum，可以说 **a miracle nostrum — “A street seller claiming that one bottle can cure every disease is selling a supposed miracle nostrum.”**

quiz.question: ____ ___ rostrum
quiz.explanation: 讲台, 走上讲台. The speaker prepared to take the rostrum. 演讲者准备走上讲台。 | rostr->鸟嘴/船嘴，rostrum->罗马广场上的演讲台（以战船喙装饰）=讲台 || 文化联想：人民大会堂或大学演讲厅里的讲台最适合帮助记忆 rostrum，可以说 **take the rostrum — “A speaker may take the rostrum before delivering a formal address to a large audience.”**

quiz.question: ___ desideratum
quiz.explanation: 迫切需要的东西, 首要需求. Peace is the top desideratum. 和平是首要需求。 | desider->渴望（拉丁），desideratum->迫切渴望的东西（cf. desire渴望） || 文化联想：中文“最想实现的目标”最适合帮助记忆 desideratum，可以说 **a top desideratum — “For many first-time homebuyers, affordability is a top desideratum when choosing where to live.”**

quiz.question: ____ stratum
quiz.explanation: 地层, 岩层. Geologists studied the ancient rock stratum. 地质学家研究古老的岩层。 | strat->铺展/层，stratum->铺展的一层=地层（复数strata，cf. strategy战略） || 文化联想：黄土高原一层层黄土沉积最适合帮助记忆 stratum，可以说 **a rock stratum — “Geologists can identify each rock stratum by differences in color, composition, and age.”**

quiz.question: ________ substratum
quiz.explanation: 基础, 文化基础. Language reflects the cultural substratum. 语言反映文化基础。 | sub->下面，stratum->层，substratum->最底下的层=基础/底层 || 文化联想：中文“文化底层结构”最适合帮助记忆 substratum，可以说 **a cultural substratum — “Ancient customs may survive as a cultural substratum beneath later religious or political traditions.”**

quiz.question: _____ dictum
quiz.explanation: 格言, 法律格言. The judge cited a famous legal dictum. 法官引用了一句著名的法律格言。 | dict->说（拉丁），dictum->所说之话=格言（cf. dictate命令，predict预言） || 文化联想：中文“法律上的明确断言”最适合帮助记忆 dictum，可以说 **a legal dictum — “A judge’s broad statement about a principle may later be quoted as a legal dictum.”**

quiz.question: ____ arboretum
quiz.explanation: 植物园, 城市植物园. The city arboretum displays rare trees. 城市植物园展示稀有树木。 | arbor->树（拉丁），arboretum->种树的地方=植物园（cf. arbor凉亭） || 文化联想：北京植物园等大型植物园最适合帮助记忆 arboretum，可以说 **a city arboretum — “A city arboretum may preserve hundreds of tree species for education, research, and public enjoyment.”**

quiz.question: ______ factotum
quiz.explanation: 杂役, 办公室杂役. The office factotum handled various tasks. 办公室杂役处理各种任务。 | fac->做，totum->一切，factotum->做一切事的人=杂役/万事通 || 文化联想：中文办公室里的“万能助理”最适合帮助记忆 factotum，可以说 **an office factotum — “A small company may rely on one office factotum who handles scheduling, supplies, errands, and basic bookkeeping.”**

quiz.question: ___ pseudonym
quiz.explanation: 笔名, 笔名. The author wrote under a pen pseudonym. 作者用笔名写作。 | pseudo->假，onym->名字，pseudonym->假名字=笔名（cf. anonymous匿名） || 文化联想：鲁迅早期使用“周树人/鲁迅”等署名背景很适合帮助记忆 pseudonym，可以说 **a pen-name pseudonym — “‘Lu Xun’ is a famous pseudonym used by Zhou Shuren for much of his literary work.”**

quiz.question: ______ acronym
quiz.explanation: 首字母缩写, 著名的首字母缩写. NASA is a famous acronym. NASA是一个著名的首字母缩写。 | acro->顶端/首位，onym->名字，acronym->取首字母组成的名字=缩写词 || 文化联想：中国互联网和公司里大量使用拼音或英文首字母缩写，最适合帮助记忆 acronym，可以说 **a familiar acronym — “A technology team may use a familiar acronym so often that newcomers first have to learn what the letters stand for.”**

quiz.question: pecan ___
quiz.explanation: 山核桃, 山核桃派. Thanksgiving dinner included pecan pie. 感恩节晚餐包括山核桃派。 | pecan->来自美洲原住民语pakani，指坚硬壳果，pecan pie->感恩节经典甜点 || 文化联想：中国烘焙店里也常见碧根果派，最适合帮助记忆 pecan，可以说 **pecan pie — “A bakery in a large Chinese city may sell pecan pie alongside cheesecakes and fruit tarts.”**

quiz.question: _____ harridan
quiz.explanation: 泼妇, 严厉的泼妇. The harsh harridan scolded everyone. 严厉的泼妇责骂每个人。 | harridan->可能源自法语haridelle（老驽马），harridan->粗暴刁蛮的老妇=泼妇 || 文化联想：中文“泼妇骂街”最适合帮助记忆 harridan，可以说 **a harsh harridan — “A fictional market woman who screams insults at everyone around her may be portrayed as a harsh harridan.”**

quiz.question: __________ paean
quiz.explanation: 赞歌, 胜利的赞歌. The poem was a triumphant paean to freedom. 这首诗是对自由的胜利赞歌。 | Paean->希腊治疗神，paean->献给神的颂歌=赞歌（注意区分peon苦力） || 文化联想：中文“凯歌”最适合帮助记忆 paean，可以说 **a triumphant paean — “A victory celebration song can become a triumphant paean praising the courage of the winning side.”**

quiz.question: lean ____
quiz.explanation: 瘦的, 瘦肉. The doctor recommended eating lean meat. 医生建议吃瘦肉。 | lean->倾斜/瘦，lean meat->无多余脂肪的肉=瘦肉 || 文化联想：中文“精瘦肉”最适合帮助记忆 lean，可以说 **lean meat — “A diner trying to reduce fat may choose lean meat instead of a heavily marbled cut.”**

quiz.question: glean ___________
quiz.explanation: 搜集, 搜集信息. Researchers glean information from various sources. 研究人员从各种来源搜集信息。 | glean->拾穗（收割后捡剩余麦穗），glean->零散搜集=搜集信息 || 文化联想：中文“从大量资料中筛出信息”最适合帮助记忆 glean，可以说 **glean information — “A historian may glean information from old newspapers, local gazetteers, letters, and court records.”**

quiz.question: demean _______
quiz.explanation: 贬低, 贬低自己. Don't demean oneself by begging. 不要通过乞求贬低自己。 | de->向下，mean->低劣，demean->使降低身份=贬低（cf. demeanor举止） || 文化联想：中文“自贬身份”最适合帮助记忆 demean，可以说 **demean oneself — “A scholar who flatters a corrupt official for a small favor may be accused of demeaning himself.”**

quiz.question: subterranean _____
quiz.explanation: 地下的, 地下河流. Explorers discovered a subterranean river. 探险者发现了地下河流。 | sub->在下，terra->土地，subterranean->在土地之下的=地下的（cf. terrain地形） || 文化联想：北京、上海地铁长期在地下穿行，最适合帮助记忆 subterranean，可以说 **a subterranean tunnel — “A subway train passes through a subterranean tunnel beneath the city streets.”**

quiz.question: epicurean _____
quiz.explanation: 美食的, 美食品味. The chef catered to epicurean taste. 厨师迎合美食品味。 | Epicurus->古希腊哲学家（主张感官享乐），epicurean->追求感官精致享受的=美食的 || 文化联想：中国美食家追求好茶、好酒和精致饮食的场景很适合帮助记忆 epicurean，可以说 **epicurean taste — “A collector who carefully compares rare teas and regional cuisines may develop an epicurean taste.”**

quiz.question: ___ empyrean
quiz.explanation: 最高天, 最高天. Angels dwell in the empyrean. 天使居住在最高天。 | empyr->火（希腊，古人认为最高天由火构成），empyrean->火的天界=最高天 || 文化联想：中国古典诗词里的“九重天”“天宫”最适合帮助记忆 empyrean，可以说 **the empyrean realm — “A poet describing immortals above the clouds may imagine the empyrean realm as radiant and remote.”**

quiz.question: protean ______
quiz.explanation: 多变的, 多变的才能. The actor possessed protean talent. 演员拥有多变的才能。 | Proteus->希腊海神（能随意变形），protean->像海神一样多变的 || 文化联想：孙悟空七十二变最适合帮助记忆 protean，可以说 **protean talent — “Sun Wukong’s seventy-two transformations make him a perfect image of protean talent and endlessly changing forms.”**

quiz.question: procrustean ____
quiz.explanation: 强求一致的, 强求一致的规则. The procrustean rule stifled creativity. 强求一致的规则扼杀了创造力。 | Procrustes->希腊神话强盗（把人拉长或截断以符合床的尺寸），procrustean->强求一致的 || 文化联想：中文“一刀切”最适合帮助记忆 procrustean，可以说 **a procrustean rule — “Forcing every school to use exactly the same policy regardless of local conditions is a procrustean rule—典型的‘一刀切.’”**

quiz.question: wean _____
quiz.explanation: 断奶, 给孩子断奶. Mothers gradually wean child from breastfeeding. 母亲逐渐给孩子断奶。 | wean->使习惯于（古英语），wean from->使脱离依赖=断奶/戒除 || 文化联想：中国家庭给孩子断奶最适合帮助记忆 wean，可以说 **wean a child — “Parents may gradually wean a child from breast milk as solid food becomes the main source of nutrition.”**

quiz.question: pagan ______
quiz.explanation: 异教的, 异教仪式. Ancient tribes practiced pagan ritual. 古代部落实行异教仪式。 | paganus->乡村居民（拉丁，基督教传入城市后乡村仍信旧神），pagan->异教徒 || 文化联想：pagan 是西方宗教史词，可用中国学生学习古希腊罗马宗教时来记忆，可以说 **a pagan ritual — “In a world-history class, Chinese students may study a pagan ritual dedicated to an ancient Greek or Roman deity.”**

quiz.question: amphibian _______
quiz.explanation: 两栖动物, 两栖动物物种. Frogs are common amphibian species. 青蛙是常见的两栖动物物种。 | amphi->两者，bio->生命，amphibian->能在两种环境生存的=两栖动物 || 文化联想：青蛙既能在水里也能在陆地生活，最适合帮助记忆 amphibian，可以说 **an amphibian species — “The Chinese giant salamander is an amphibian species adapted to life in cool mountain streams.”**

quiz.question: ______ academician
quiz.explanation: 院士, 院士成员. She was elected a member academician. 她被选为院士成员。 | Academy->柏拉图的学园（雅典地名），academician->学术机构的正式成员=院士 || 文化联想：中国科学院院士最适合帮助记忆 academician，可以说 **an academy academician — “A distinguished scientist may be elected as an academician of a national academy after decades of influential research.”**
